svg.text: A 6-month chart is rewritten to hit the hourly rollups, so a few thousand points rather than millions

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 10M+ data points/s, sub-second dashboard queries over days, alerts within seconds, extreme storage efficiency

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Cardinality: a series = metric name + tag combination; a bad tag like user_id creates billions of series. Quota per tenant (e.g. 100k active series) and a 429 circuit breaker

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Sharding: Kafka and TSDB sharded by hash(tenant id, metric name) so one metric lands on one node and aggregation stays local
